_about: MPPP site definitions: the sol range of each block that notebook 03 aligns. Keys are the site names used in folder names (v0p53: mars2020_sol_<first sol, 4 digits>_<site>_colmap; ..._colmap_zcam for the Navcam + Mastcam-Z block). 'sols' = [first, last] sol of the block (inclusive); nearby waypoints (ADD_NEARBY_WAYPOINTS) can add other visits. 'zcam' = the Mastcam-Z zooms (mm) of the site's Navcam + Mastcam-Z block, a list of 34, 48, 63, 110 ([] = Navcam only; v0p53, replaces 'zcam34': true). 'settings' = notebook 03 overrides for this site (JSON values), applied by scripts/run_sites.py and scripts/align_scape.py. 'no_mask_inference_at' = stations (S###D####) where the mask model is off. Groups name site lists for run_sites.py --group; run_all_sites.bat runs navcam_consensus, run_all_sites_zcam.bat zcam_consensus (every Mastcam-Z consensus block, all its zooms), run_all_sites_zcam34.bat zcam34_consensus (48, 63 and 110 likewise). Edit here, then run check_sites.bat; notebook 03 reads this file (SITES_FILE).
